---
title: "Image Display Size"
format: html
filters:
  - gallimaufry
extensions:
  gallimaufry:
    image-display-size: true
---

## Width/height migration

This filter moves `width`/`height` attributes from a `.cell` div onto the nested image inside `.cell-output-display`.
The effect is visible in computational output where Quarto wraps figures in cell divs.

::: {.cell width="50%"}
::: {.cell-output-display}

![A resized image](https://placehold.co/600x300)

:::
:::
